sampling.rule: Stratified deliberately, not randomly. Pool: 1,018 live notes under /root/vault (archive/, .claude/ and templates/ excluded), of which 981 declare one of the nine types in frontmatter, carry a non-empty description and have a body of at least 450 characters. Every note is one of those 981.
sampling.type_strata: All nine declared types are represented: the four most frequent types (extract, pattern, insight, moc) and the two mid-frequency types (decision, error) get at least five each, the three rare types (claim, principle, manual) at least one each, and the five top hubs by au_hubs (index, zeroclaw-decisions, agentic-architecture, memory-systems, jev) are always included.
sampling.staleness_screen: Oversampled descriptions that looked stale before reading: description shorter than 90 characters, a generic 'Topic map for ... / Current ... / Complete reference ...' description, or a description naming an entity, count or status that does not occur in the body. At least ten screen hits are included; each is labelled on its own evidence, and a screen hit that turns out accurate is labelled not stale (the screen is a sampler, not a label).
sampling.duplicate_search: Title-token Jaccard over the 981-note pool (every pair at 0.50 and above that involves a sampled note is read), then au_grep for a distinctive phrase and au_content on both sides of each candidate pair. A note names a same-claim partner only when both bodies assert the same proposition; otherwise it records the closest rejected title match. duplicate_candidate is the note the duplicate noul compares against: the named partner when one exists, otherwise a deterministic different-type probe, so the gold answer to that pair is 'no'.
sampling.reproduction_note: Roles and languages follow the vault (Russian descriptions occur next to English bodies); no note text was rewritten.

# No Forgetting Mechanism Remembers Everything Anti-Pattern

The system stores every fact, conversation snippet, and observation without decay, consolidation, or pruning. Over time, outdated facts compete with current ones during retrieval. # Ontology as Single Source of Truth: Code Never Primary

Критический принцип ODD: код никогда не является первичным источником истины. Им является Онтология.

## Проблема drift

В [[three-ontology-approaches-reference-vs-model-driven-vs-runtime]] онтологии используются только на этапах требований. Код пишут вручную. Риск: код становится де-факто спецификацией, игнорируя исходные архитектурные намерения.

## Решение: Формальная иерархия

```
Онтология (LinkML/OWL)
 ↓ (компиляция)
Типы (Pydantic/TypeScript/Rust)
 ↓ (имплементация)
Код (бизнес-логика)
```

Если код требует изменений:
1. Обновить `schema.yaml` (онтология) или `.tla` (спецификация)
2. Регенерировать привязки
3. Код адаптируется к новым типам
